holderProfileId.description: Credential profile whose store currently holds the session; null = the harness default store.

file.description: Absolute path of the located history file (the holder); null until located.

mtimeMs.description: Modification time of the located file (newest wins on a tie); null until located.

sidecars.description: Absolute paths of sibling state a move must carry (claude `<sid>/` tool-results and subagents; codex rollout parts).

cwd.description: Working directory the session was created under.

requestedModel.description: The model the spec requested; null = the harness default.

SessionCapsule.description: Durable per-attempt record of the native vendor session and its holder file.
